CutoutDecals - photo-derived alpha cutouts (leaves, foliage cards, grass, weeds, stains, cracks,
scuffs, litter, graffiti). Prepared October 17, 2026. Not yet imported or checked in Unity.

All source photographs are CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication):
  - Poly Haven (polyhaven.com) models: potted_plant_01, potted_plant_02, weed_plant_02,
    flower_empodium, can_rusted, old_tyre, book_encyclopedia_set_01, trashbag, long_life_food,
    rollershutter_door, rollershutter_window_01 (1k diffuse textures, fetched from GitHub mirrors).
  - ambientCG (ambientcg.com, Lennart Demes): Ground037, Ground049C, Ground053, Ground072,
    Ground079S, Asphalt010, Asphalt021, Concrete033 (2K-JPG Color maps, via the
    Dadaskis/TextureArchive mirror).
Exact raw URLs and commits are in sources.json.

Derived images (cut-outs, recolours, composites) were made for this project with
Source~/build_cutouts.py and are likewise released under CC0 1.0. No attribution is required;
courtesy credit: "Photographs: Poly Haven and ambientCG, CC0".
Product labels in Litter_Atlas and the graffiti come from Poly Haven's own fictional textures.
